self.description: Sandrone A1: Prism Shot ke-2 (Stellar-Conduct) ×400% saat Decoding Power > 50.
Sandrone A4: EM +8 per 100 ATK (max 160). TIDAK masuk total Enka (diverifikasi in-game 2026-09-11: Enka 82, layar stat 242).
Polestar Field yang dipicu Sandrone sendiri (butuh Electro di tim). Nol kalau Odette ada di tim (sudah dihitung entry polestar_field di _team.json).
Sandrone passive Stellar Jubilee (ke diri sendiri): Base DMG reaksi Stellar +0.7% per 100 ATK, max 14%.

_limits_comment: Fagio: Decoding Power naik selama beam; mentok 100 → Power Overdrive (beam lemah, na4 'DMG When in Power Overdrive') sampai <50; E me-repair. Kalibrasi in-game 2026-09-11: CA ke-3 berturut-turut tanpa E ≈ overdrive (Sandrone real 1.23M vs 27 beam penuh 1.99M → ≈18 beam penuh = 2 CA penuh per E). KQM combo default C0 = 3[C E] (C lalu E, bukan 3 C berturut).

rotations.label: 3[C E] (Q) Stellar-Conduct
rotations.note: ≈10s (aproksimasi). KQM combo 3[C E] (Q). 3 condensed beam per C (teks C6: beam ke-3 = Cluster Beam); varian Stellar-Conduct (butuh Electro di tim). Per-hit diverifikasi in-game 2026-09-11 (Sweeping Fire 3.027, beam biasa 8.628, beam Stellar maks 73.191 vs program 69.347).
